name: validation-compensated
cmd: set -euo pipefail; bash research/track-m/prepare-vendors.sh; bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null; cp source-projection-base.txt core/count-recovery/derivability-closure.ts; LAB_DISPOSABLE=1 bun research/track-m/lane-f-scalar-source-variant.ts; LAB_DISPOSABLE=1 bun research/track-m/lane-f-source-cdcl-variant.ts; LAB_DISPOSABLE=1 bun research/track-m/lane-f-prefer-compensated-variant.ts; LAB_DISPOSABLE=1 bun research/track-m/lane-f-source-order-variant.ts compensated; bun test research/track-m/prefer-compensated.test.ts core/count-recovery/live-dependencies.test.ts core/count-write-frames.test.ts core/count-focused.test.ts core/count-ranges.test.ts core/count-recovery/empty-count-source.test.ts core/count-recovery/derivability-closure.test.ts core/count-recovery/row-demand.test.ts core/count-recovery/row-cases.test.ts core/count-recovery/conditional-cuts.test.ts; bun run check; for file in audit-fix-commit.txt transport-commit.txt audit-report-commit.txt source-order-commit.txt; do printf 'COMMITLINT %s\n' "$file"; bunx commitlint --default-config < "$file"; done
